deadline_note: Rolling: applications accepted from the first to the last working day of every month; December applications are taken under the next year's budget. Checked 31 Oct 2026.

summary.en: Batumi City Hall co-funds young Batumi residents aged 18-29 who have been invited to an internship, training, exchange, volunteering or other international project abroad. Winners receive up to 3,000 GEL towards travel, visa, insurance and participation fees.
summary.ka: ბათუმის მერია თანადაფინანსებს 18-29 წლის ბათუმელ ახალგაზრდებს, რომლებიც უცხოეთში სტაჟირებაზე, ტრენინგზე, გაცვლით, მოხალისეობრივ ან სხვა საერთაშორისო პროექტზე არიან მიწვეულნი. გამარჯვებულები იღებენ 3000 ლარამდე მგზავრობის, ვიზის, დაზღვევისა და მონაწილეობის ხარჯებისთვის.
summary.ar: تشارك بلدية باتومي في تمويل الشباب المقيمين في باتومي (18-29 عاماً) المدعوين إلى تدريب أو تبادل أو تطوع أو مشروع دولي آخر في الخارج، بمنحة تصل إلى 3000 لاري لتغطية السفر والتأشيرة والتأمين ورسوم المشاركة.

about.en:
This Batumi City Hall programme (sub-programme 'Support for Professional Development') helps young people from Batumi take up opportunities abroad: professional internships, practical placements and retraining, as well as educational, cultural, sports, youth, volunteering and other international projects, trainings and courses. It works as co-funding: you already hold an invitation and some funding, and the city adds up to 3,000 GEL.

Applications are accepted every month, from the first to the last working day. A commission reviews the file and interviews applicants within ten working days after the month closes; you need at least 60% of the maximum score to be recommended, and the mayor's order confirms the grant. Costs incurred before the contract is signed are not reimbursed, so apply well before you travel. After the trip you submit a short report and copies of passport stamps.

Useful for Batumi students accepted to Erasmus+ youth exchanges, summer schools, conferences or internships whose costs are not fully covered.

en: Up to 3,000 GEL per person for travel, visa, insurance and fees
Monthly intake all year; decision within about 10 working days
Covers internships, trainings, exchanges, volunteering and sports or cultural projects abroad

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia aged 18-29 registered as residents of Batumi municipality, who hold higher or vocational education or are currently enrolled at an authorised university or vocational college, and have a written invitation to the project abroad. Documents in Georgian (foreign-language documents need a notarised translation).

en: Download the regulation, application form (Annex 2) and recommendation form (Annex 4) from the programme page on batumi.gov.ge
Collect: ID/passport copy, proof of Batumi registration, recommendation letter, invitation, two 3x4 photos, proof of co-funding (bank statement or sponsor letter) and proof of study or education
Submit the file at Batumi City Hall's records office, 25 Luka Asatiani Street, between 09:00 and 18:00 during the month
Attend the commission interview; if approved, sign the contract with the City Hall before travelling
Within two months after the project, submit the programme report (Annex 5) and passport stamp copies

costs.en: Free to apply. One-off grant of up to 3,000 GEL covering travel, visa, insurance, registration or participation fees; the applicant must show co-funding for the rest.

score_reason: Real money (up to 3,000 GEL) for Batumi youth, open every month

name.en: Batumi City Hall: Youth Initiatives Grant (up to 4,000 GEL)

name.ar: بلدية باتومي: منحة مبادرات الشباب (حتى 4000 لاري)

duration.en: Rolling monthly calls; project carried out within the budget year

duration.ar: استقبال شهري متجدد؛ يُنفَّذ المشروع خلال السنة المالية

deadline_note: Rolling: applications accepted every month of the budget year; November/December applications are taken under the next year's approved budget. Checked 31 Oct 2026.

summary.en: Young people aged 14-29 registered in Batumi can win up to 4,000 GEL from the City Hall to run their own event or project: education, culture, sport, ecology, career, science or civic initiatives. Applications are reviewed monthly by a commission.
summary.ka: ბათუმში რეგისტრირებულ 14-29 წლის ახალგაზრდებს შეუძლიათ მერიისგან 4000 ლარამდე მიიღონ საკუთარი ღონისძიების ან პროექტის განსახორციელებლად: განათლება, კულტურა, სპორტი, ეკოლოგია, კარიერა, მეცნიერება ან სამოქალაქო ინიციატივა.
summary.ar: يمكن للشباب المسجلين في باتومي من سن 14 إلى 29 عاماً الحصول على ما يصل إلى 4000 لاري من البلدية لتنفيذ فعالية أو مشروع خاص بهم في التعليم أو الثقافة أو الرياضة أو البيئة أو العلوم أو العمل المدني.

about.en:
Under its Youth Centre sub-programme, Batumi City Hall funds events designed and led by young people themselves. Eligible themes include education and culture, sport and healthy lifestyles, youth policy, hiking, cycling and water-sports tourism, educational excursions, exhibitions of crafts, career guidance, young scientists, ecology and environmental protection, and civic engagement. Each project can receive up to 4,000 GEL (taxes included).

Projects must be participatory events (not equipment purchases or websites), held in Batumi during the budget year, ideally at least 22 days after the monthly application window closes. A commission scores relevance, duration (longer projects score higher) and the applicant's capacity to deliver, and may interview you or ask for a 5-minute presentation. There is no fixed number of winners until the annual budget runs out.

A practical way for school and university students in Batumi to fund a club, festival, workshop or volunteering campaign and gain project-management experience.

en: Up to 4,000 GEL for your own youth project
Open from age 14 (minors apply with a parent)
Monthly decisions; no limit on number of winners until the budget is used

eligibility.en: Individuals aged 14-29 registered as residents of Batumi municipality. Applicants under 18 apply through a legal guardian. Documents must be in Georgian.

en: Download the regulation and application form (Annex 2) from the programme page on batumi.gov.ge
Prepare the application, CV, recommendation letter, ID copy, proof of Batumi registration (or civil registry screenshot), bank details and, for items over 500 GEL, two price quotes
Submit at Batumi City Hall's records office, 25 Luka Asatiani Street, during any month's window
Present your project to the commission (in person or by phone) if invited
If funded, sign the contract, run the event and submit programme and financial reports within 15 days

costs.en: Free to apply. Grant of up to 4,000 GEL paid against documented expenses; costs before the contract are not reimbursed.

score_reason: Open to school pupils from 14, up to 4,000 GEL, rolling

duration.ka: დაახლოებით 4 კვირა (აგვისტოს შუა რიცხვებიდან სექტემბრის შუა რიცხვებამდე)
duration.ar: نحو 4 أسابيع (من منتصف أغسطس إلى منتصف سبتمبر)

deadline_note: Annual since 2019; the 2027 audition call and dates are not yet published (2026 residency ran 15 Aug-14 Sep). Expect auditions in spring 2027; watch the PCYO site.

summary.en: A fully funded symphony orchestra for young musicians aged 18-28 from Georgia and the wider region, resident each summer at the Tsinandali Festival in Kakheti under music director Gianandrea Noseda. Members get coaching, rehearsals and four festival concerts.
summary.ka: სრულად დაფინანსებული სიმფონიური ორკესტრი 18-28 წლის ახალგაზრდა მუსიკოსებისთვის საქართველოდან და რეგიონიდან, რომელიც ყოველ ზაფხულს წინანდლის ფესტივალზე მუშაობს ჯანანდრეა ნოზედას ხელმძღვანელობით.
summary.ar: أوركسترا سيمفونية ممولة بالكامل للموسيقيين الشباب (18-28 عاماً) من جورجيا والمنطقة، تقيم كل صيف في مهرجان تسيناندالي في كاخيتي بقيادة المايسترو جياناندريا نوسيدا.

about.en:
The Pan-Caucasian Youth Orchestra was founded in 2019 and is resident at the Tsinandali Festival in Kakheti, eastern Georgia. Each summer selected young musicians spend about four weeks in Tsinandali: seating auditions, coaching and sectionals with international tutors, full-orchestra rehearsals with Maestro Gianandrea Noseda, then four concerts at the festival (the 2026 cycle ran 15 August-14 September).

It is for orchestral musicians aged 18-28 born in Georgia or the region; the FAQ lists Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Turkey, Turkmenistan, Ukraine and Uzbekistan. Younger players can ask for permission to audition. Applicants submit an online form and give a roughly 10-minute audition (solo pieces plus listed orchestral excerpts); results come about a week after auditions end.

The festival covers travel to Tsinandali, shared accommodation and meals, with no fee to apply or take part, which makes it one of the most valuable orchestral experiences for young musicians in the Caucasus.

en: Travel, accommodation and meals covered; no fees
Work with Gianandrea Noseda and international coaches
Four concerts at one of the region's leading classical festivals

eligibility.en: Orchestral musicians aged 18-28 with some orchestra experience, born in Georgia or another eligible country of the region (Armenia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Turkey, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan). Under-18s must request permission (sonja@tsfest.ge).

en: Read the audition programme and FAQ on pcyo.tsinandalifestival.ge
Fill in the online application when the 2027 call opens and choose your audition date
Prepare one or two pieces plus the listed orchestral excerpts (bring your own pianist if needed)
Attend the audition (or request a remote format by email); results arrive about a week after auditions close

costs.en: Free to apply. If selected, travel to and from Tsinandali, accommodation and meals are covered. Health, accident and instrument insurance are your own responsibility.

score_reason: Fully funded, prestigious; 2027 dates still to be announced

name.en: Gori State University 5th International Student Scientific Conference 'Education and Innovation' 2026
name.ka: გორის სახელმწიფო უნივერსიტეტის სტუდენტთა მეხუთე საერთაშორისო სამეცნიერო კონფერენცია „განათლება და ინოვაციები“ 2026
name.ar: المؤتمر العلمي الدولي الخامس للطلاب في جامعة غوري الحكومية «التعليم والابتكار» 2026

duration.ar: يوم واحد (10 ديسمبر 2026)، حضوري وعن بُعد

deadline_note: Information letter: application form and paper to conference@gu.edu.ge by 20 November 2026 inclusive.

summary.en: A free hybrid research conference where bachelor's and master's students from Georgia and abroad present a paper orally and as a poster. Papers are accepted in Georgian, English or Russian across eight sections from education to sport management.
summary.ka: უფასო ჰიბრიდული სამეცნიერო კონფერენცია, სადაც საქართველოსა და უცხოეთის ბაკალავრები და მაგისტრანტები ნაშრომს ზეპირად და პოსტერის სახით წარადგენენ. სამუშაო ენებია ქართული, ინგლისური და რუსული.
summary.ar: مؤتمر بحثي مجاني (حضوري وعن بُعد) يقدّم فيه طلاب البكالوريوس والماجستير من جورجيا والخارج أوراقهم شفهياً وبملصق علمي، باللغات الجورجية أو الإنجليزية أو الروسية.

about.en:
Gori State University (Shida Kartli) holds its fifth International Student Scientific Conference, 'Education and Innovation', on 10 December 2026. It runs in hybrid mode: in person at the university in Gori and online via Zoom. Each participant presents one paper (alone or with up to two co-authors) both orally and as a poster, and receives a certificate.

Sections: education and pedagogy; mathematics and informatics; exact and natural sciences; business, economics and tourism; social sciences and law; philology; history; sport and sport management. Papers of up to 12 A4 pages (Georgian, English or Russian) follow APA style and include an English abstract of up to 300 words and 4-5 keywords; a programme committee selects the talks.

A low-barrier first conference for undergraduates who want a presentation and a certificate on their CV; no registration fee.

en: No registration fee; online participation possible
Open to bachelor's and master's students from any country
Eight subject sections; certificate for presenters

eligibility.en: Bachelor's and master's students of universities in Georgia or abroad. One paper per participant, with at most two co-authors. Working languages: Georgian, English, Russian.

en: Download the application form and information letter from the conference page on gu.edu.ge
Write your paper (max 12 pages, APA style, English abstract of up to 300 words, 4-5 keywords)
Email the completed form and the paper (.doc, named by surname) to conference@gu.edu.ge by 20 November 2026
If selected, present orally and with a poster on 10 December, in Gori or via Zoom

costs.en: Free. The university covers conference costs; travel and accommodation are not reimbursed.

score_reason: Free, international, online option; deadline 20 Nov

name.ar: بلدية باتومي: دعم سفر الرياضيين للمشاركة في البطولات (حتى 4000 لاري)

duration.en: Rolling monthly calls (one-off grant per tournament)
duration.ar: استقبال شهري متجدد (منحة لمرة واحدة لكل بطولة)

deadline_note: Rolling: applications accepted from the first to last working day of each month except November; December applications go to the next year's budget. Checked 31 Oct 2026.

summary.en: Batumi-registered athletes, including school-age competitors applying with a parent, can get up to 4,000 GEL from the City Hall to travel to national or international tournaments. The grant covers travel, visa, insurance, hotel, entry fees and sports kit.
summary.ka: ბათუმში რეგისტრირებულ სპორტსმენებს, მათ შორის არასრულწლოვნებს მშობლის მეშვეობით, შეუძლიათ მერიისგან 4000 ლარამდე მიიღონ ეროვნულ ან საერთაშორისო ტურნირებში მონაწილეობისთვის: მგზავრობა, ვიზა, დაზღვევა, სასტუმრო, საფასური და ეკიპირება.
summary.ar: يمكن للرياضيين المسجلين في باتومي، بمن فيهم القاصرون عبر أولياء أمورهم، الحصول على ما يصل إلى 4000 لاري من البلدية للسفر إلى بطولات وطنية أو دولية، تشمل السفر والتأشيرة والتأمين والفندق ورسوم المشاركة والمعدات.

about.en:
Under the sub-programme 'Support for the Individual Development of Batumi Athletes', Batumi City Hall co-funds athletes and coaches registered in Batumi who are going to sports tournaments, including international ones. The aim is to help them gain competition experience and raise their level. Each winner receives a one-off advance of up to 4,000 GEL for travel, visa, insurance, hotel, tournament fees and sports equipment.

Applications are accepted every month (except November), and a commission decides within ten working days after the month closes. You need an invitation or proof of entry, a recommendation from the national federation or the Adjara federation of your sport, and proof that part of the cost is covered by you or a sponsor. Minors apply through a parent. Within 30 days after the tournament you submit a short report.

A useful route for young Batumi athletes selected for European or world youth championships whose federations cannot cover all costs.

en: Up to 4,000 GEL per tournament
Open to minors through a parent; no upper age limit
Monthly intake with decisions in about 10 working days

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia registered in Batumi municipality who are athletes or coaches with an invitation to a sports tournament and a recommendation from the Georgian national federation or the Adjara federation of their sport. Applicants under 18 apply with a parent's documents. Documents in Georgian.

en: Download the regulation and application form from the programme page on batumi.gov.ge
Prepare: application, CV, passport/ID copy (plus parent's ID and birth certificate for minors), proof of Batumi registration, federation recommendation, invitation, and proof of co-funding
Submit at Batumi City Hall, 25 Luka Asatiani Street, during the monthly window
After approval sign the contract; within 30 days after the tournament submit the programme report

costs.en: Free to apply. One-off advance of up to 4,000 GEL for travel, visa, insurance, hotel, entry fees and sports kit; co-funding required.

score_reason: Real travel money for Batumi athletes, rolling

name.ar: بلدية باتومي: دعم الفنانين المشاركين في المسابقات والمهرجانات الدولية (حتى 2000 لاري)

duration.en: Rolling monthly calls (one-off grant per event)
duration.ar: استقبال شهري متجدد (منحة لمرة واحدة لكل فعالية)

deadline_note: Rolling: applications accepted every month of the budget year; November/December applications also taken under the next year's budget. Checked 31 Oct 2026.

summary.en: Musicians, actors, visual and film artists who live or work in Batumi, including young performers applying with a parent, can get up to 2,000 GEL to take part in international competitions, festivals or exhibitions. The grant covers travel, visa, insurance and registration fees.
summary.ka: ბათუმში მცხოვრებ ან მოღვაწე მუსიკოსებს, მსახიობებს, სახვითი და კინოხელოვანებს, მათ შორის არასრულწლოვნებს, შეუძლიათ 2000 ლარამდე მიიღონ საერთაშორისო კონკურსებში, ფესტივალებსა და გამოფენებში მონაწილეობისთვის.
summary.ar: يمكن للموسيقيين والممثلين والفنانين التشكيليين والسينمائيين المقيمين أو العاملين في باتومي، بمن فيهم القاصرون، الحصول على ما يصل إلى 2000 لاري للمشاركة في مسابقات ومهرجانات ومعارض دولية.

about.en:
Batumi City Hall's 'Support for Artists' sub-programme funds artists who have been invited to international cultural projects: competitions, festivals and exhibitions abroad or in Georgia. Priority goes to music, audiovisual, fine arts and theatre. Each winner gets a one-off advance of up to 2,000 GEL for travel, visa, insurance and registration costs.

Applications are accepted every month and a working group decides within about ten working days. You need an official invitation or proof of participation, a recommendation letter, a CV and, if available, recordings or images of your work. Applicants under 18 apply with a parent's documents, so the scheme suits music-school pupils and young performers selected for international contests.

It does not pay fees for the competition itself unless they are registration costs, and expenses before the contract are not refunded, so apply as soon as you receive your invitation.

en: Up to 2,000 GEL per international event
Priority for music, film, fine arts and theatre
Minors can apply through a parent

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia who work as artists in Batumi or are registered in Batumi municipality at the time of application, with an official invitation to an international cultural project. Under-18s apply with a parent's ID and their birth certificate. Documents in Georgian.

en: Download the regulation and the 2026 application form from the programme page on batumi.gov.ge
Attach: recommendation letter, CV, passport/ID copy, proof of registration, invitation, bank details and (optional) a CD/portfolio of your work
Submit at Batumi City Hall, 25 Luka Asatiani Street, in any monthly window
If approved sign the contract, travel, then submit the report form

costs.en: Free to apply. Up to 2,000 GEL for travel, visa, insurance and registration fees.

score_reason: Helps young Batumi artists reach international contests; rolling

name.ar: برنامج التطوع في المتحف الوطني الجورجي

deadline_note: Standing programme with no published deadline; applications go to the museum's administrative service. Checked 31 Oct 2026.

summary.en: Volunteer in a department of the Georgian National Museum or one of its museums to gain hands-on museum, research and visitor-work experience. Open to motivated people of different ages with secondary or higher education.
summary.ka: იმოხალისე საქართველოს ეროვნული მუზეუმის განყოფილებაში ან მის რომელიმე მუზეუმში და მიიღე პრაქტიკული გამოცდილება. პროგრამა ღიაა საშუალო ან უმაღლესი განათლების მქონე მოტივირებული ადამიანებისთვის.
summary.ar: تطوّع في أحد أقسام المتحف الوطني الجورجي أو متاحفه لاكتساب خبرة عملية في العمل المتحفي والبحثي واستقبال الزوار. البرنامج مفتوح للمتحمسين من مختلف الأعمار الحاصلين على تعليم ثانوي أو عالٍ.

about.en:
The Georgian National Museum unites Georgia's main state museums (including the Simon Janashia Museum in Tbilisi and regional units such as the Svaneti Museum in Mestia and the Vani Archaeological Museum). Its volunteer programme takes people who want to raise their professional level, build museum-related skills and deepen their general education by working alongside staff in a chosen department.

The museum accepts volunteers of different ages who have completed secondary or higher education and are interested in museum work. It looks for motivation, willingness to learn, responsibility and punctuality; computer skills and a foreign language help for some projects. You state the department and role you want in your application.

A strong CV item for students of history, archaeology, art history, conservation, tourism or education, and a way to see a national museum from the inside.

en: Choose the museum department you want to work in
Open year-round, no deadline
Good fit for history, archaeology, art and heritage students

eligibility.en: People of any age who have completed secondary education (school leavers, university students, graduates) and are interested in museum work. A recommendation from a school, university or employer is expected but may be waived. Georgian is the working language; a foreign language is an advantage.

en: Read the volunteer programme page on museum.ge
Prepare an application naming the department and position you want, a recommendation, CV, copy of your diploma or a certificate from your school/university, ID copy and two photos
Submit to the museum's administrative service (contact +995 32 299 80 22)
Wait to be contacted about placement and schedule

score_reason: Rolling, accessible volunteering at Georgia's national museum

org: Zugdidi Municipality City Hall (Sports and Youth Affairs Division)

name.en: Zugdidi City Hall: Youth Project Funding and Co-Funding (up to 5,000 GEL)
name.ka: ზუგდიდის მერია: ახალგაზრდული პროექტების დაფინანსება და თანადაფინანსება (5000 ლარამდე)
name.ar: بلدية زوغديدي: تمويل مشاريع الشباب والتمويل المشترك (حتى 5000 لاري)

deadline_note: Rolling: the commission meets as needed, usually in the first week of each month; one grant per organisation per year. Checked 31 Oct 2026.

summary.en: Youth organisations can get up to 5,000 GEL from Zugdidi City Hall for projects with at least about 25 young people aged 14-29 registered in Zugdidi municipality, including internally displaced youth. Projects up to 2,000 GEL are fully funded.
summary.ka: ახალგაზრდულ ორგანიზაციებს შეუძლიათ ზუგდიდის მერიისგან 5000 ლარამდე მიიღონ პროექტებისთვის, რომლებშიც ზუგდიდში რეგისტრირებული 14-29 წლის ახალგაზრდები (მათ შორის დევნილები) მონაწილეობენ. 2000 ლარამდე პროექტები სრულად ფინანსდება.
summary.ar: يمكن لمنظمات الشباب الحصول على ما يصل إلى 5000 لاري من بلدية زوغديدي لمشاريع تشرك نحو 25 شاباً على الأقل (14-29 عاماً) مسجلين في زوغديدي، بمن فيهم النازحون داخلياً.

about.en:
Zugdidi municipality (Samegrelo) funds projects that organisations run with and for local young people aged 14-29, both residents and internally displaced persons. Themes include healthy lifestyles, gender equality, youth entrepreneurship, personal development through non-formal education, inclusive education and other projects that meet young people's needs and Georgia's youth policy goals.

Projects costing up to 2,000 GEL can be funded in full; between 2,000 and 5,000 GEL the City Hall co-funds up to 90%. A commission usually meets in the first week of each month and the applicant presents the project (online attendance allowed). Each organisation can use the programme once a year, and a report with photos, a participant list and proof of spending is due within a month after the project.

Useful for student clubs, youth NGOs and school-based initiative groups in Zugdidi that need a first grant for a camp, training, exchange or campaign.

en: Up to 5,000 GEL; projects up to 2,000 GEL fully funded
Monthly commission, rolling applications
Projects can also take local youth to events outside Zugdidi or abroad

eligibility.en: Organisations working in the youth field (NGOs and similar legal entities) whose project targets young people aged 14-29 registered in Zugdidi municipality (local or IDP), ideally at least about 25 participants. Documents in Georgian.

en: Read the rules on the programme page on zugdidi.gov.ge and download the application annex
Prepare: application to the Mayor, project form with budget and plan, public registry extract, representative's ID, bank details, and parental consent if minors travel outside Zugdidi
Submit to Zugdidi City Hall (hotline 591 54 40 44, info@zugdidi.gov.ge)
Present the project at the commission meeting (in person or online)
Run the project and report within one month

costs.en: Free to apply. Up to 5,000 GEL per project (full funding up to 2,000 GEL; up to 90% co-funding above that).

score_reason: Rolling local grant, but applicants must be organisations

org: Environmental Information and Education Centre (EIEC), Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture of Georgia

name.en: Essay Contest 'Human Footprint on Soil' 2026 (World Soil Day)
name.ka: ესეების კონკურსი „ადამიანის კვალი ნიადაგზე“ 2026 (ნიადაგის მსოფლიო დღე)
name.ar: مسابقة المقالات «أثر الإنسان على التربة» 2026 (اليوم العالمي للتربة)

duration.ar: التقديم من 20 أكتوبر إلى 20 نوفمبر 2026؛ التكريم في 5 ديسمبر

deadline_note: Contest page: submissions 20 October-20 November 2026; award ceremony 5 December 2026.

summary.en: A national essay contest for school pupils in grades 7-12 across Georgia on soil protection, tied to World Soil Day 2026. Write 300-600 words in Georgian and email it by 20 November.
summary.ka: ეროვნული ესეების კონკურსი საქართველოს სკოლების VII-XII კლასის მოსწავლეებისთვის ნიადაგის დაცვაზე, ნიადაგის მსოფლიო დღესთან დაკავშირებით. დაწერე 300-600 სიტყვა და გამოგზავნე 20 ნოემბრამდე.
summary.ar: مسابقة مقالات وطنية لتلاميذ الصفوف 7-12 في مدارس جورجيا حول حماية التربة بمناسبة اليوم العالمي للتربة 2026. اكتب 300-600 كلمة بالجورجية وأرسلها قبل 20 نوفمبر.

about.en:
The Environmental Information and Education Centre (EIEC), the environmental education agency of Georgia's Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture, runs this essay contest for World Soil Day (5 December). The 2026 campaign theme is soil compaction: 'Stop soil compaction, increase soil productivity'. Pupils are asked what footprint people leave on soil and what soil we should leave to future generations.

It is open to pupils of general schools anywhere in Georgia in two categories: grades 7-9 and grades 10-12. Essays of 300-600 words in Georgian (Word or PDF, Sylfaen 12, 1.5 spacing) must describe the problem and its causes, give examples, state your own opinion and propose solutions, with sources cited. A jury scores out of 100, rewarding depth of understanding (25), argument (20) and independent thinking (20) over the amount of information.

Winners in 1st-3rd place in each category receive certificates named after academician Tengiz Urushadze at a ceremony on 5 December 2026. A quick, free entry for pupils interested in environment, agriculture or biology.

en: Two categories: grades 7-9 and 10-12
Short essay (300-600 words), entry by email
Award ceremony on World Soil Day, 5 December

eligibility.en: Pupils in grades 7-12 of general education schools in Georgia. Essays must be in Georgian and the pupil's own work.

en: Read the contest conditions on eiec.gov.ge
Write a 300-600 word essay in Georgian (Word or PDF, Sylfaen 12, 1.5 spacing) with sources
Email it to info@eiec.gov.ge by 20 November 2026 with your name, surname, school, contact details and a short description of the work

score_reason: Open now, national, low effort; deadline 20 Nov

org: Ministry of Education and Sport of the Autonomous Republic of Adjara with colleges 'Blacksea' (Batumi) and 'Akhali Talgha' (Kobuleti)

name.en: Adjara Grant for Vocational Students' Exchanges Abroad (up to 5,000 GEL)
name.ka: აჭარა: პროფესიული განათლების ინტერნაციონალიზაციის საგრანტო კონკურსი პროფესიული სტუდენტებისთვის (5000 ლარამდე)
name.ar: أجاريا: منحة لطلاب التعليم المهني للتبادل في الخارج (حتى 5000 لاري)

duration.en: Exchange of at least 1 month abroad
duration.ar: تبادل لمدة شهر على الأقل في الخارج

deadline_note: Programme launched in 2026 (budget 50,000 GEL); students apply through the partner colleges within the colleges' own competition windows. Ask the college for the current round. Checked 31 Oct 2026.

summary.en: Vocational students registered in Adjara can win up to 5,000 GEL to spend at least a month on an exchange at a vocational school in the EU, UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Japan, Switzerland or Norway. Applications go through the Blacksea and Akhali Talgha colleges.
summary.ka: აჭარაში რეგისტრირებულ პროფესიულ სტუდენტებს შეუძლიათ 5000 ლარამდე მიიღონ ევროკავშირის, ბრიტანეთის, აშშ-ის, კანადის, ავსტრალიის, იაპონიის, შვეიცარიის ან ნორვეგიის პროფესიულ სასწავლებელში არანაკლებ ერთთვიანი გაცვლისთვის.
summary.ar: يمكن لطلاب التعليم المهني المسجلين في أجاريا الحصول على ما يصل إلى 5000 لاري لقضاء شهر على الأقل في تبادل بمؤسسة مهنية في الاتحاد الأوروبي أو بريطانيا أو أمريكا أو كندا أو أستراليا أو اليابان أو سويسرا أو النرويج.

about.en:
Adjara's Ministry of Education and Sport started this programme in 2026 to help vocational students add international experience to their training at home. It funds exchange programmes of at least one month at vocational institutions in EU member states, the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Japan, Switzerland or Norway; for dual (work-based) programmes, placements can be with employers proposed by the partner colleges' foreign partners.

The grant (up to 5,000 GEL) can cover registration on the exchange programme, housing and utilities, international travel, health insurance, visa costs, food and local transport. Students apply to one of the two partner colleges, the public colleges 'Blacksea' in Batumi and 'Akhali Talgha' in Kobuleti, which select candidates in their own competitions and nominate them to the ministry.

A concrete way for students in hospitality, tourism, IT, construction or other trades in Adjara to train abroad.

en: Up to 5,000 GEL per student
Exchanges of 1 month or more in Europe, North America, Japan or Australia
Apply through Blacksea (Batumi) or Akhali Talgha (Kobuleti) college

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia registered in Adjara for at least one year before the call, who are vocational students and will take part in an exchange vocational programme of at least one month in an eligible country.

en: Read the conditions and regulation on the ministry's page
Contact your college: Blacksea (Batumi, info@blacksea.edu.ge) or Akhali Talgha (Kobuleti, info@kpc.ge)
Apply in the college's competition and, if selected, get nominated to the ministry
Sign the grant agreement and keep receipts for reimbursable costs

costs.en: Grant of up to 5,000 GEL for documented exchange costs.

score_reason: Good funding for vocational students; application windows set by colleges

name.ar: أولمبياد فرق الأطفال للغناء والرقص الشعبي في أجاريا (2027)

duration.en: Municipal rounds in May, then a final gala
duration.ka: მუნიციპალური ტურები მაისში, შემდეგ დასკვნითი გალა
duration.ar: جولات بلدية في مايو ثم حفل ختامي

deadline_note: Annual; the 2026 edition was announced on 8 April 2026 with selection rounds on 18-23 May in each Adjara municipality. 2027 dates not yet published. Checked 31 Oct 2026.

summary.en: An annual competition for children's choirs and folk dance ensembles across Adjara, with more than 80 ensembles and 2,000 young performers each year. Winners receive awards including stage costumes.
summary.ka: ყოველწლიური კონკურსი აჭარის ბავშვთა საგუნდო და ქორეოგრაფიული ფოლკლორული ანსამბლებისთვის, რომელშიც ყოველწლიურად 80-ზე მეტი ანსამბლი და 2000-ზე მეტი ახალგაზრდა შემსრულებელი მონაწილეობს.
summary.ar: مسابقة سنوية لجوقات الأطفال وفرق الرقص الشعبي في أجاريا، يشارك فيها كل عام أكثر من 80 فرقة و2000 مؤدٍّ صغير، وتُمنح الفرق الفائزة جوائز منها أزياء المسرح.

about.en:
Every year Adjara's Ministry of Culture holds the Olympiad of Children's Folk Song and Dance Ensembles to showcase traditional Georgian folk song and dance among young people, discover talented performers and let ensembles share new creative work. More than 80 choreographic and choral ensembles with over 2,000 performers take part.

The olympiad runs in stages: selection rounds in every Adjara municipality (in 2026 these took place on 18-23 May, starting with Khulo and Shuakhevi), followed by a final gala concert and awards ceremony. Winning ensembles (Grand Prix and first places) receive prizes such as stage costumes and accessories.

Pupils take part as members of a school, music-school or community folk ensemble; joining a local ensemble in Batumi, Kobuleti, Khelvachauri, Keda, Shuakhevi or Khulo is the way in.

en: 80+ ensembles and 2,000+ young performers each year
Rounds in every Adjara municipality
Prizes include stage costumes for winning ensembles

eligibility.en: Children's folk choirs and dance ensembles from the Autonomous Republic of Adjara; individual pupils participate through their ensemble.

en: Join a school, music-school or community folk ensemble in Adjara
Ask the ensemble leader to register when the ministry announces the 2027 olympiad (spring)
Perform in the municipal round; top ensembles go on to the final gala

score_reason: Large free regional arts contest; via ensembles only; 2027 dates pending
